descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-25 Web & Phone Sync · S11 「电脑上打了查房前文字，但还没用 Save Note 存」 Pre-round text typed on the computer but not yet saved with Save Note

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 A pre-round note dictated and saved on the computer appears on the phone in real time, with no refresh, and can be continued on the phone without re-entering anything.（UAT TC-25 step 3；UAT TC-25；TFA-94513 AC 11；TFA-94704 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog
  • U6 Steps 2-5 (add, pre-round save, generate, delete) work the same in Nursing Home as in Hospital.（UAT TC-25 step 6；UAT TC-25；UAT 3.3） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress; TFA-94704 development backlog

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Both devices signed in; {hospitalPatient}

When Computer opens the notes editor, types pre-round text and does not tap Save Note or close the editor; 3 s later (past the 800 ms autosave) the phone opens the chart, appends a line and waits 3 s; the computer keeps the editor open. Run in both modes

Then The phone shows the computer's unsaved-but-typed text and can continue it without re-entering anything; the computer then shows both lines without a refresh

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 (phone) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-2' (it starts the 60-character notepad preview); cp2 (computer, editor open the whole time, no reload) mustContain 'QA-SYNC-PR-2' and 'QA-SYNC-PR-3', read from the editor's textbox, which holds the full text (the closed row shows only the first 60 characters, PreRoundNotesCard.tsx:236, and 'QA-SYNC-PR-3' starts at character 51). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-25.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
